summary: Outcome-driven, artifact-first headless benchmark runner and deterministic graders for Clash creative work.
context_hints: The execution agent receives only the outcome contract and copied built-in skills; rubric checks remain outside its workspace.
Never grade from the agent final message. Resolve submission paths inside the isolated workspace, reject symlinks, hash files, and independently validate artifacts.
Required rubric gates fail closed even when the weighted score exceeds the pass threshold.
Director v1 is structural unless real rendered media exists; MG character v1 is the geometric 2D profile, not a skeletal rig.

key_files.src/schemas.ts: Versioned benchmark, outcome, submission, and rubric schemas.
key_files.src/evaluator.ts: Director, Timeline, MG, media, artifact-set, and mixed-lineage grading.
key_files.src/runner.ts: Isolated workspace provisioning, skill installation, native Codex and Claude Code execution, logs, and outcome result generation.
key_files.src/cli.ts: CLI entry point for real Codex, Claude Code, and command-based benchmark runs.
key_files.src/claude-adapter.test.ts: Claude print-mode arguments, Project Host readiness before stdio MCP binding, skills, stream-json trajectory, and error contracts.
key_files.src/index.test.ts: Artifact security, hard-gate, mixed-source, suite, and real child-process runner contracts.
